from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionReport(BaseModel):
    """One data row for a specific month extracted from a single construction report."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, formatted YYYY-MM")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the report providing this data, formatted YYYY-MM-DD")
    units_under_construction_growth_pct: float | None = Field(description="Month-over-month percentage change in units under construction (5+ units)")
    completions_growth_pct: float | None = Field(description="Month-over-month percentage change in housing completions (5+ units)")
    unit_category: str | None = Field(description="The category of buildings covered (e.g., 'five_or_more_units')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_reports: list[MonthlyConstructionReport]
